testcase.system-out: Scenario: Export customization settings covering multiple interface areas ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the current customization has no staged changes ✔ When the user exports the current settings to a new XML file ✔ Then the XML file parses as a customization settings document ✔ And it contains ribbon state, custom panel, and quick access toolbar settings ✔ And it contains keyboard mapping settings ✔ And it contains marking menu and mini-toolbar settings ✔ And the customization dialog remains open
